archivedDescription:
WALLET operation "bridge".
WALLET family: Route wallet operations through registered chain handlers and analytics providers. Use action=transfer|swap|bridge|gov|pump_fun_buy for on-chain ops (params: target, toChain, fromToken, toToken, amount, recipient, slippageBps, mode, dryRun; pump_fun_buy takes toToken and amount and no target); action=token_info for token/market data (params: operation, target, query, address, chain, limit); action=search_address for Birdeye wallet/portfolio lookup (param: address).

archivedDiscriminator.description: Subaction discriminator (auto-set to "bridge" for this virtual; do not change). (e.g. transfer, swap, bridge, gov, pump_fun_buy, token_info, search_address)
